messages:
Alex Morgan: Quick heads-up — planning to cut the dependency/lockfile bump before Friday's release cutoff. Anyone with vendoring or submodule changes that need to land earlier?

Tasha Li: I have a submodule PR (github.com/redwood/.../submod-update) that updates a patch-level commit for the tokenizer. Needs a rebase against main, should be small. ETA EOD Thu.

Daniel R.: FYI my vendor bump (grpc v1.12.3 -> v1.13.0) is blocked by a failing test in auth. Trying a patch now, but might slip past cutoff unless someone can approve a quick rollback.

Priya Nair: I can take the changelog entry and do the release-notes draft once the final versions are pinned. Ping me when PRs are merged.

Alex Morgan: Thanks. If Daniel's bump is flaky, prefer we patch rollback and re-land next cycle. We want a clean CI before cut. @Daniel R. can you post the failing test output?

Daniel R.: Here's the failing test: 
```
FAIL auth_test.py::TestTokenRefresh::test_expired
AssertionError: expected 200 but got 403
```
Likely related to a behavior change in grpc auth headers. I'm bisecting.

Tasha Li: Rebase done for mine, pushed a force with note. PR link in thread. CI green locally but flaky in matrix.

ci-bot: [CI] build #3124 failed on integration matrix (linux-3). Logs: https://ci.internal/3124

Alex Morgan: OK — plan:
- If any PR still failing by 17:00 PT tomorrow, we rollback vendor bump to previous lock and comment on changelog with 'deferred'
- Submodule PRs that are rebased + passing CI by 12:00 PDT Fri will be prioritized for merge
- Priya will prepare a placeholder changelog entry tagged 'pending versions'

Tasha Li: ack, I'll try to shepherd the flakes. If I can't get green by noon I'll add a comment to defer.

Priya Nair: I'll draft the changelog now and add an item for 'tokenizer submodule update (pending).' Will update when versions are final.

Alex Morgan: Great. Also, small ask: if you open any last-minute patch, include a short rollback plan in the PR description and add "release-blocker: no" label unless it truly must ship.

Daniel R.: Got it. If I can't fix the auth test, I'll open a rollback PR with the label.

Alex Morgan: Thanks team. I'll send a short note in the release channel 1 hour before cutoff. :thumbsup:
